# htmx v4 Internal Architecture Guide (Unofficial)

> Source-level internal architecture guide to htmx v4.0.1: single-class Htmx & private field lowering, HCON & explicit :inherited resolution, trigger lexer & RequestQueue state machine, fetch() streaming & extraction, Idiomorph DOM…

## Overview

- [Architecture Overview](https://htmx.drawlib.com/architecture/en/): htmx v4.0.1 ("The Fetchening") is a complete ground-up architectural rewrite of htmx, replacing the legacy 4,000+ line XMLHttpRequest closure of htmx 2.x…

- [2. Attribute Inheritance & HCON](https://htmx.drawlib.com/architecture/en/02_attribute_inheritance_and_hcon.html): htmx v4.0.1 unifies attribute configuration parsing and DOM inheritance around two foundational mechanisms in src/htmx.js: HCON (htmx Configuration Object…
- [3. Trigger & Selector Parsers](https://htmx.drawlib.com/architecture/en/03_trigger_and_selector_parsers.html): htmx v4.0.1 replaces rigid regular-expression attribute parsers with two composable micro-engines built on top of HCON: a 3-Layer Trigger Closure Synthesizer…
